campaign: Amouage Opus V / Woods Symphony PW research interpretation R1
claim: A testable product-level iris/rhum/oud-civet/dry-wood interpretation; not an authenticated Amouage formula

basis.target: 100.00 parts by mass of named PW products as supplied, before user-added working-stock carriers
basis.default_evaluation_load: 24.00 percent w/w named-source-product equivalents, not pure oil assay

reference_lock.edition: Opus V / Woods Symphony Eau de Parfum; current marketed architecture

concentration_conflict.older_faq: 20% pure oils; basis unspecified; 2+4 week ageing
concentration_conflict.resolution: Use our own 24% w/w product-load trial; no claim of exact original loading or identical current/2011 batches

working_concentrate.assumes: Specified product identities, fractions and homogeneous stocks; proposed preparations are not existing inventory by implication

volumetric_bottle_rule: No g=mL inference. Prepare a sufficient mass at chosen w/w load and measure the final 30 mL separately; remaining perfume is retained, not discarded.

candidate_families.name: Root-Rum Lead
candidate_families.reason: Balances all official axes without a big vanilla, leather or amberwood chassis

candidate_families.name: Butter and wax emphasis
candidate_families.risk: Wax haze and cosmetic heaviness; literal notes do not prove the authentic dosage

candidate_families.name: Drier decomposed rum bridge
candidate_families.risk: Less distinctive brown-rum depth; ester-fruit drift

candidate_families.name: Simplified iris and wood control
candidate_families.risk: May be easier to mix but loses root/cask grain; not automatically inferior

candidate_families.name: Product-based oud/root alternative
candidate_families.risk: Named Black Agarwood product is not natural oud equivalent; natural-root nuance may be lost

candidate_families.name: Darker wood and civet
candidate_families.risk: Animalic/tobacco dominance; do not select merely for power

trial_recipes.question: Does the complete target read as iris/rhum/dry woods with secondary animality?
Does the named rum product improve rum recognizability, or just add syrup/tropical fruit?
Does civet add a useful undertone rather than fecal dirt?
Does the warmer single musk make Habanolide unnecessary?
Does the cleaner single musk make Ambrettolide unnecessary?

trial_rules.first_three: LEAD, NO_RUM_PRODUCT, NO_CIVET_PRODUCT; two single-musk trials optional
trial_rules.all_masses: Nominal unrounded quantities; actual nearest-0.001g transfers and alcohol q.s. to 5.000g must be recorded
trial_rules.omission_state: Blanked at same finished mass; fewer source-product equivalents than lead; not relabeled 24% odorants

hard_gates.measurability: MINIMUM_PROPOSED_MASTER_TRANSFER_20_MG; scale actual accuracy not inferred from resolution
hard_gates.sensory: NOT_TESTED; reject if iris unclear, gourmand/rose-oud/leather/amberwood drift or overt fecality
hard_gates.solubility: NOT_TESTED; no visibly heterogeneous sample used as a homogeneous stock

historical_integer_search.reason: No matched Opus V empirical objective or validated 35-guardrail contract; no 97.76/100 or 35/35 claim
